2\. Sub-agents edit protected mission metadata 📘 Rule violation § Compliance 
The U0 plan commit modifies meta/plan.md and meta/CHECKPOINT.md, despite the mission's standing
constraint that sub-agents must not edit those files. Protected planning state can therefore be
rewritten by an automated unit, leaving later builders with metadata that does not reflect the
designated owner's checkpoint or plan.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The PR modifies `meta/plan.md` and `meta/CHECKPOINT.md`, which the compliance rule reserves from sub-agent edits. ## Fix Focus Areas - meta/plan.md[1-4] - meta/CHECKPOINT.md[3-6] ## Recommended Fix Remove the sub-agent-authored changes to `meta/plan.md` and `meta/CHECKPOINT.md`, or move the plan and checkpoint updates into an owner-controlled step that is not performed by a sub-agent. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
